paragraphs.text: Claire D'Loon is a human performer and balloon artist of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Although there is a balloon-making robot in the park, Claire is the artist and purveyor of the art of balloons. Though the robot is faster, it can't provide the artistry and passion that Claire does. Claire even takes it one step further: her balloons come alive.
Myra originally did not see the need to hire Claire, as she already had a balloon maker. However, Claire managed to wow Myra and get a job at the park. She is as much a performer as she is an artist.
